name: Pipe Post
summary: A Send button that rolls your note into a capsule and shoots it through a brass air tube
about: A feedback or contact form with an old-fashioned air tube on top. Press Send and your note lifts off the text box and drops into the inlet, the pressure needle swings up, and a glass capsule races through the brass tube, loop and all, lighting the tube behind it. It lands in the front desk box, whose door pops open and lamp turns green, and the note appears in the desk's inbox. Good for contact forms, support chats and feedback boxes.
how: Type a note (and your name if you like), then press Send or Enter. An empty note makes the box shake and asks for a few words.
The note flies down into the inlet, which squashes as the capsule loads, and the pressure needle jumps.
The capsule speeds up and slows down along the tube with whoosh lines while the tube glows behind it.
At the front desk the box bounces, the door opens, the lamp turns green, the note lands in the inbox and the button shows Delivered before resetting.
